---
title: Alerts and callouts
# callouts.md: markdown-dialect.md §4.7
---

> [!NOTE]
> A note.

> [!TIP] Useful advice
> A tip with a title.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Important information.

> [!WARNING]
> A warning.

> [!CAUTION]
> A caution.

> [!nOtE] Mixed case
> Tags are case-insensitive.

> [!UNKNOWN]
> An unknown alert tag remains a block quote.

:::callout warning title="Check the quota"
An explicit callout kind and title.
:::

> An ordinary block quote.
